high_level_description: The image depicts a person standing on a rooftop with a stunning view of the New York City skyline in the background. The individual is wearing a white crop top and black wide-legged pants, accessorized with gold hoop earrings, a bracelet, and rings. They have long, dark hair that falls over their shoulders. The setting appears to be during the evening or early morning, as the sky has a soft, muted blue hue, suggesting either dawn or dusk. The person is leaning against a metal railing, which is part of the rooftop structure.
